scopeEvidence.text: Upon receiving the applicable regulatory approvals, the Company invested $2.00 billion in SpaceX common stock (formerly a preferred share investment in xAI) representing an ownership interest of less than 1% in March 2026. We have determined that under the applicable accounting standards, we are presumed to have significant influence over SpaceX and as such, we account for this investment using the equity method of accounting. Refer to Note 1, Summary of Significant Accounting Policies, regarding the fair value policy election in relation to the equity investment and Note 2, Fair Value of Financial Instruments, for the gain recognized on our SpaceX equity investment.
